title: An exception with a line field
description: You can carry an error's formatted message and structured location together.

steps.description: ConfigError inherits from Exception. Its initializer passes a formatted message to the parent and stores line as a separate field.
You enter a try block with a matching ConfigError handler below it. That handler can access the raised object as e.

steps.question: What message and field value will the handler print?
steps.answer: The message is line 7: bad value, and e.line is 7. The print places a vertical bar between them.

steps.description: You see line 7: bad value | 7. The caught object provides both its readable message and its stored line number.
